narrative: Four levers explain most of MoraBanc's earnings risk: the ECB deposit rate (about EUR 6.2M of NII per 100 bps), AUM growth (about EUR 0.9M of fees per point), cost of risk (EUR 1.8M per 10 bps on the loan book) and the efficiency ratio (EUR 2.1M of cost per point). The probability-weighted outcome is close to the Q3 forecast, with the Rates & Markets Down case the main downside.

signals.title: Net interest income down 6.6% as rates fall
signals.excerpt: Interest income fell from €102.3M to €95.9M; NII from €86.5M to €80.8M while loans grew 13.5% to €1.72Bn.

signals.title: Net fees now exceed net interest income
signals.excerpt: Net fees €91.6M vs NII €80.8M; gross fees +33% to €132.9M with Tressis and the Spanish bank in the perimeter.
